description: Rural Vermont depends on strong community relationships, and our law enforcement officers play a vital role in keeping our towns safe. They serve not only as first responders, but as neighbors and trusted members of the community.As Nicholas DiLorenzo, and a former U.S. Army Military Police Officer, I understand the dedication and sacrifice required to serve. Our officers face growing challenges with limited resources, staffing shortages, and increasing public safety demands in rural communities
title: Rural Vermont Stands with Law Enforcement
